chapter: Rhythm Club, studio dates and the 1930s big bands
title: Chick Webb's collective head arrangements and Prez on dates
summary: The Webb band's "Tiger Rag" and blues were built by the men together; the same went for Duke and for Billie Holiday and Lester Young dates.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
